findings.title: Narrative-fabrication forms are rejected by CR-62 after the round-3 fix
findings.evidence: Round 1: a blockquoted fabricated quotation (probe A9) and a quantifier-less fabricated observation (probe A10) were accepted at 61/61. Round 2 added CR-62 and rejected those forms but left six inline attribution forms accepted (A9e, B1, B2, B3, B4, B9). Round 3 at f083c78 adds optional-article support to the dash and pre-quotation rules, reverse-order and parenthetical rules, and no longer exempts closing-quote rules from the meta-quote guard. In a fresh throwaway fixture at f083c78, all six residual probes are rejected by CR-62, as are A9, A9b, A9c, A9d and A10; unresolvable pseudonymous participant references are rejected anywhere in a document; the real tree still validates at 62/62; the suite is 96/96. Data-contract section 2.8 and the validator header now match the implementation. Verified closed in round 3.
findings.remediation: No further action for the preparation scope. Keep the CR-62 rules and the new negative tests in place.

findings.title: CR-47 now scans application-layer content, not only filenames
findings.evidence: Round 1: participant-content JSON under a throwaway fixture src/ directory with a neutral filename passed at 61/61, and CR-47 was the only check without a negative test. At a7645f6 and again at f083c78, CR-47 content-scans src/, public/ and deploy/ for participant, interview, consent, price-response and contact markers. Probe A11 (participant JSON under src/ with a neutral filename) and probe A11b (interview-record Markdown under public/ with a neutral filename) are both rejected with CR-47, and the suite contains a CR-47 negative test. Verified closed in round 2 and re-verified in round 3.
findings.remediation: No further action; keep the content scan and the negative test in place.

findings.criterion: Heuristic breadth of the narrative-fabrication check
findings.title: CR-62 is a heuristic limited to the documented lexical forms
findings.evidence: Breadth probes at f083c78 returned 62/62 for four variants outside the documented forms: a role noun placed before a reporting verb outside the covered verb set; a quotation using single-quote characters; a quotation using guillemet characters; and a fabricated quotation attributed to a role noun outside the English list. Data-contract section 2.8 lists the covered inline forms in prose but does not state the lexical limit, and the validator header is silent on it. The tree contains zero quotations of any form (guillemet and single-quote attribution scans returned zero), so this is a breadth limit of a heuristic control rather than an open fabrication path in an existing document; the twelve probes that previously demonstrated a real bypass are all rejected.
findings.remediation: Either extend CR-62 to additional quotation characters, bilingual role nouns and a wider reporting-verb set, or record the lexical scope explicitly in data-contract section 2.8 and the validator header. Required before any Spanish-language narrative reporting or before the gate is relied on for quotations in languages other than English. Not blocking for the current preparation scope; Lead may fold it into the delivery commit or schedule a follow-up.
